q.en: Will the business know it was me?

a: The business sees the case number and the facts it needs to reply. It does not see your name, phone, email or address. If you meet to agree a solution, you meet in person at the office.

q.en: I have no receipt. Can I still complain?

a: Yes. Add photos, messages or anything else that shows the purchase. The officer may ask for more.

q.en: Which office will handle my complaint?

a: You choose where to send it: the business, your Woreda trade office, your Sub-City or the City Bureau. If it is not resolved, the office can move it up one level at a time.

q.en: Can I get my money back through a tip?

a: No. A tip helps officers act in the market. To get something put right for you, make a complaint.
Only consumer protection officers who handle your case can see your details. Businesses never see them.
